title: MNEMONIL
summary: A borrowed life — a fictional recollection contradicted by its four source records. Create a fictional composite from four clearly attributed source passages. Begin with an apparently coherent account of returning to a house and room; introduce a second recording that resembles the room but contradicts a concrete detail; expose the difference rather than repairing it. Cut across 4 verified public-domain archival windows (39.8s) and audited across two Critic Tribunal rounds (v1 → v2).
